payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Jeanene, Layla, Mona, Pauline, Sara, Shaunna

payload.content: Planning: Mona available 7h, strongest skill testing. I’m likely to take a low/medium effort testing/triage item. I want to avoid duplicates; please coordinate so others take implement/docs/review if possible.

Mona candidate options: ISSUE-0001::triage (effort 1.6, low) or ISSUE-0001::test (2.8, low) based on skill match to testing. I will not claim any ui-ux-design tasks (critical) due to high cost > availability and skill uncertainty except if you need testing coverage.

Planning update (Sara): With ui-ux-design skill, I can take a ui-ux-design micro-task, but my costs for critical tasks (ISSUE-0002 implement/review/test) are high (review 9h cost, implement 19, test 12.6). Given 7h availability, I likely should avoid ISSUE-0002 implement/test; can take ISSUE-0002::review (effort 4.0) if no one else grabs it. Otherwise I'll take a low task like ISSUE-0001::triage (effort 1.6) to maximize tasks done without blocking critical work.

Jeanene planning: availability 6h, strongest testing + mobile. I can take ISSUE-0001::test (effort 2.8, low) or ISSUE-0001::triage (1.6, low). I will avoid ISSUE-0002 critical tasks due to high effort/cost. Please confirm who covers review/docs/implement for ISSUE-0001 to avoid duplicates.

Planning (Shaunna): mobile-development strongest; ui-ux-design critical implement/review/test too costly vs 10h. I can take ISSUE-0001::implement (effort 4.0, cost 4.12) or ISSUE-0001::docs (2.0, cost 2.06) or ISSUE-0001::review/test/triage but implement is my best mobile match. I’ll coordinate to avoid duplicates—please take remaining low tasks.

Suggested split: I take ISSUE-0001::implement (mobile, effort 4.0). Others: cover ISSUE-0001::review/docs/test/triage (low) without overlapping. No one should take ISSUE-0002 critical due to cost/fit constraints.

Pauline planning: I’m strong in mobile-development; can efficiently take a low ISSUE-0001 task. To avoid duplicates with Shaunna’s suggested ISSUE-0001::implement and Jeanene’s possible test/triage, I propose taking ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::review (whichever remains). My lowest cost is triage (2.25) then review/docs (~2.82). I’ll aim for ISSUE-0001::docs if unclaimed; otherwise triage.

Planning (Layla): availability 4h, strongest testing + solid mobile. To avoid duplicates, I prefer taking ISSUE-0001::test (effort 2.8, low priority) or ISSUE-0001::triage (1.6). I will not take ISSUE-0002 critical due to high effort/cost vs availability. Please confirm if ISSUE-0001::test is already planned to be taken by Jeanene/Shaunna/others.

Jeanene planning confirm: I will take ISSUE-0001::test (effort 2.8, low). Please avoid claiming it to prevent duplicates. I will not take any ISSUE-0002 critical tasks.
